raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
H ^ {\prime} = \lambda x ^ {2} y z.
$$

(a) 基态.  
(b) 第一激发态(三重简并).提示 利用习题 2.12 和习题 3.39 的结果.
raw_problem.solution_text:
在直角坐标系中，各向同性的三维谐振子的波函数可以表示为一维谐振子波函数的乘积，即

$$
\psi_ {n _ {x} n _ {y} n _ {z}} (x, y, z) = \psi_ {n _ {x}} (x) \psi_ {n _ {y}} (y) \psi_ {n _ {z}} (z),
$$

$$
E _ {n _ {x} n _ {y} n _ {z}} = \left(n _ {x} + n _ {y} + n _ {z} + \frac {3}{2}\right) \hbar \omega , \quad n _ {x}, n _ {y}, n _ {z} = 0, 1, 2, 3, \dots
$$

(a) 对于基态，波函数为

$$
\psi_ {0} (x, y, z) = \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {0} (z),
$$

它是非筒并的，能量的一阶修正为

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {0} ^ {(1)} = \langle 0 | H ^ {\prime} | 0 \rangle = \int \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (x) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (y) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) \lambda x ^ {2} y z \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {0} (z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z \\ = \lambda \int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (x) x ^ {2} \psi_ {0} (x) \mathrm {d} x \underbrace {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (y) y \psi_ {0} (y) \mathrm {d} y} _ {0} \underbrace {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) z \psi_ {0} (z) \mathrm {d} z} _ {0} \\ = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) 对于第一激发态，波函数有三种情况

$$
| 1 \rangle = | \psi_ {1} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {0} (z) \rangle , \quad | 2 \rangle = | \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {1} (y) \psi_ {0} (z) \rangle ,
$$

$$
\left| 3 \right\rangle = \left| \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {1} (z) \right\rangle ,
$$

所以第一激发态三重筒并，在以这三个态为基矢的简并子空间，微扰矩阵元为

$$
H _ {1 1} ^ {\prime} = \langle 1 | H ^ {\prime} | 1 \rangle = \int \psi_ {1} ^ {*} (x) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (y) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) \lambda x ^ {2} y z \psi_ {1} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {0} (z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = 0,
$$

$$
H _ {2 2} ^ {\prime} = \langle 2 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 \rangle = \int \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (x) \psi_ {1} ^ {*} (y) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) \lambda x ^ {2} y z \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {1} (y) \psi_ {0} (z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = 0,
$$

$$
H _ {3 3} ^ {\prime} = \langle 2 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 \rangle = \int \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (x) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (y) \psi_ {1} ^ {*} (z) \lambda x ^ {2} y z \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {1} (z) \mathrm {d} x \mathrm {d} y \mathrm {d} z = 0,
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} H _ {1 2} ^ {\prime} = \left(H _ {2 1} ^ {\prime}\right) ^ {*} = \langle 1 | H ^ {\prime} | 2 \rangle \\ = \int \psi_ {1} ^ {*} (x) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (y) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) \lambda x ^ {2} y z \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {1} (y) \psi_ {1} (z) d x d y d z = 0, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} H _ {1 3} ^ {\prime} = \left(H _ {3 1} ^ {\prime}\right) ^ {*} = \langle 1 | H ^ {\prime} | 3 \rangle \\ = \int \psi_ {1} ^ {*} (x) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (y) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) \lambda x ^ {2} y z \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {1} (z) d x d y d z = 0, \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} H _ {2 3} ^ {\prime} = \left(H _ {3 2} ^ {\prime}\right) ^ {*} = \langle 2 | H ^ {\prime} | 3 \rangle \\ = \int \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (x) \psi_ {1} ^ {*} (y) \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) \lambda x ^ {2} y z \psi_ {0} (x) \psi_ {0} (y) \psi_ {1} (z) d x d y d z \\ = \lambda \underbrace {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (x) x ^ {2} \psi_ {0} (x) \mathrm {d} x} _ {\hbar / 2 m \omega} \underbrace {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {1} ^ {*} (y) y \psi_ {0} (y) \mathrm {d} y} _ {\sqrt {\hbar / 2 m \omega}} \\ \times \underbrace {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {0} ^ {*} (z) z \psi_ {1} (z) \mathrm {d} z} _ {\sqrt {\hbar / 2 m \omega}} = \lambda \left(\frac {\hbar}{2 m \omega}\right) ^ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

设 $\kappa \equiv \lambda \left( \frac { h } { 2 m \omega } \right) ^ { 2 }$ ，微扰矩阵可以写为

$$
\boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {\prime} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \kappa \\ 0 & \kappa & 0 \end{array} \right),
$$

解久期方程，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left| \begin{array}{c c c} - E _ {1} ^ {(1)} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & - E _ {1} ^ {(1)} & \kappa \\ 0 & \kappa & - E _ {1} ^ {(1)} \end{array} \right| = 0 \\ \Rightarrow E _ {1} ^ {(1)} = \left\{ \begin{array}{c} - \kappa \\ 0 \\ \kappa \end{array} \right.. \\ \end{array}
$$

串串串习题 7.37 范德瓦耳斯相互作用.考虑两相距为 $R$ 的原子.因为它们都是电中性的，你可能认为它们之间没有力作用，但如果它们是可极化的，它们之间有一个弱的相互作用.为模拟该系统，将每个原子都看作由一个电子(质量为 $m$ ，电荷为 $- e$ )

通过一个弹簧(弹性系数为 $k$ ) 连接到原子核(电荷为 $+ e '$ ，如图 7.7 所示.假设核很重，而且基本不动.无微扰系统的哈密顿量为

![](images/628d96ab5fd639445d82061ea0011715d5b2a4aca6dc9fb5f601beb4cba667f3.jpg)  
7.7 两个相邻的极化原子(习题 7.37)

$$
H ^ {0} = \frac {1}{2 m} p _ {1} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {1} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2 m} p _ {2} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {2} ^ {2}.
$$

原子间的库仑相互作用为

$$
H ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{R} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{R - x _ {1}} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{R + x _ {2}} + \frac {e ^ {2}}{R - x _ {1} + x _ {2}}\right).
$$

(a) 解释方程 (7.104). 假设 $| x _ { 1 } |$ 和 $\left| x _ { 2 } \right|$ 都远小于 $R$ 证明

$$
H ^ {\prime} \cong - \frac {e ^ {2} x _ {1} x _ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}.
$$

(b) 证明:系统总的哈密顿量 $H ^ { 0 }$ 加上方程 (7.105)) 可分解为两个谐振子哈密顿量

$$
\overline {{H}} = \left[ \frac {1}{2 m} p _ {+} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} \left(k - \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) x _ {+} ^ {2} \right] + \left[ \frac {1}{2 m} p _ {-} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} \left(k + \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) x _ {-} ^ {2} \right],
$$

其中变量变换为

$$
x _ {\pm} \equiv \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(x _ {1} \pm x _ {2}\right), \text {这 意 味 着} p _ {\pm} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(p _ {1} \pm p _ {2}\right).
$$

(c) 显然，该哈密顿量的基态能量为

$$
E = \frac {1}{2} \hbar \left(\omega_ {+} + \omega_ {-}\right), \text {其 中} \omega_ {\pm} = \sqrt {\frac {k \mp \left(e ^ {2} / \left(2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}\right)\right)}{m}}.
$$

若没有库仑相互作用，则 $E _ { 0 } = \hbar \omega _ { 0 }$ ，其中 $\omega _ { 0 } = \sqrt { k / m }$ 假设 $k \gg ( e ^ { 2 } / ( 2 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R ^ { 3 } ) )$ ,证明:

$$
\Delta V \equiv E - E _ {0} \cong - \frac {\hbar}{8 m ^ {2} \omega_ {0} ^ {3}} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}\right) ^ {2} \frac {1}{R ^ {6}}.
$$

结论:原子之间存在一个相互吸引势，它的大小和原子间距的六次方成反比，这就是两中性原子间的范德瓦耳斯相 作用.

(d) 现在利用二阶微扰理论做同样的计算.提示 无微扰态的形式是 $\psi _ { n 1 } \left( x _ { 1 } \right)$ $\psi _ { n 1 }$ '$\psi _ { n 2 } \left( x _ { 2 } \right)$ 其中 $\psi _ { n } \left( x \right)$ 是质量为 $m$ ，弹性系数为 $k$ 的单粒子谐振子的波函数; $\Delta V$ 是方程 (7.105) 中微扰对基态能量的二阶修正(注意到能量一阶修正为零).q)

解答 (a) 7.7 中两个核子(正电荷)的库仑势为 $\frac { e ^ { 2 } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R }$ 两个电子之间的库仑势为 $e ^ { 2 } / [ 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } ( R -$ $x _ { 1 } + x _ { 2 } ) ]$ ，第一个核子与第三个原子中电子的库仑势为 $- e ^ { 2 } / [ 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } ( R + x _ { 2 } ) ]$ ]，第三个核子与第一个原子中的电子的库仓势为 $- e ^ { 2 } / [ 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } ( R - x _ { 1 } ) ]$ 所以原子间库仑相互作用为

$$
H ^ {\prime} = \frac {1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{R} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{R - x _ {1}} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{R + x _ {2}} + \frac {e ^ {2}}{R - x _ {1} + x _ {2}}\right).
$$

由于 $x _ { 1 } \ll R , x _ { 2 } \ll R$ 可得

$$
{\frac {e ^ {2}}{R - x}} = {\frac {e ^ {2}}{R \left(1 - x / R\right)}} \approx {\frac {e ^ {2}}{R}} \left(1 - {\frac {x}{R}} + {\frac {x ^ {2}}{R ^ {2}}} + \dots\right),
$$

因此，

$$
\begin{array}{l} H ^ {\prime} = \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R} \left[ 1 - \frac {1}{1 - x _ {1} / R} - \frac {1}{1 + x _ {2} / R} + \frac {1}{1 - (x _ {1} - x _ {2}) / R} \right] \\ = \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R} \left\{1 - \left[ 1 - \frac {x _ {1}}{R} + \left(\frac {x _ {1}}{R}\right) ^ {2} + \dots \right] - \left[ 1 + \frac {x _ {2}}{R} + \left(\frac {x _ {2}}{R}\right) ^ {2} + \dots \right] \right. \\ \left. + \left[ 1 - \frac {x _ {1} - x _ {2}}{R} + \left(\frac {x _ {1} - x _ {2}}{R}\right) ^ {2} + \dots \right] \right\} \\ \approx \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R} \frac {- 2 x _ {1} x _ {2}}{R ^ {2}} \\ = - \frac {e ^ {2} x _ {1} x _ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b)

$$
\begin{array}{l} H = \frac {p _ {1} ^ {2}}{2 m} + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {1} ^ {2} + \frac {p _ {2} ^ {2}}{2 m} + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {2} ^ {2} - \frac {e ^ {2} x _ {1} x _ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}} \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {1} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {2} ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {1} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {2} ^ {2} - \frac {e ^ {2} x _ {1} x _ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

做变量变换 $x _ { \pm } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( x _ { 1 } \pm x _ { 2 } \right) \Rightarrow x _ { 1 } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( x _ { + } + x _ { - } \right) , x _ { 2 } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 } } \left( x _ { + } - x _ { - } \right) .$

$$
\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {1}} = \frac {\partial x _ {+}}{\partial x _ {1}} \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} + \frac {\partial x _ {-}}{\partial x _ {1}} \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} + \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}}\right),
$$

$$
\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {2}} = \frac {\partial x _ {+}}{\partial x _ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} + \frac {\partial x _ {-}}{\partial x _ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}}\right).
$$

则

$$
\begin{array}{l} H = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {1} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {2} ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {1} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} k x _ {2} ^ {2} - \frac {e ^ {2} x _ {1} x _ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}} \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left[ \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} + \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}}\right) \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} + \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}}\right) + \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}}\right) \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {+}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {-}}\right) \right] \\ + \frac {1}{2} k \cdot \frac {1}{2} (x _ {+} + x _ {-}) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} k \cdot \frac {1}{2} (x _ {+} - x _ {-}) ^ {2} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}} \cdot \frac {1}{2} (x _ {+} + x _ {-}) (x _ {+} - x _ {-}) \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {+} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {-} ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{2} \left(k - \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) x _ {+} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} \left(k + \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) x _ {-} ^ {2} \\ = \left[ \frac {p _ {+} ^ {2}}{2 m} + \frac {1}{2} \left(k - \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) x _ {+} ^ {2} \right] + \left[ \frac {p _ {-} ^ {2}}{2 m} + \frac {1}{2} \left(k - \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) x _ {-} ^ {2} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

显然这是两个一维谐振子的哈密顿量之和，所以基态能量为

$$
E = \hbar \left(\omega_ {+} + \omega_ {-}\right), \quad \omega_ {\pm} = \sqrt {\frac {k \mp [ e ^ {2} / (2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}) ]}{m}}.
$$

若 $k \gg e ^ { 2 } / 2 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } R ^ { 3 }$ ，则

$$
\begin{array}{l} \omega_ {\pm} = \sqrt {\frac {k \mp [ e ^ {2} / (2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}) ]}{m}} = \sqrt {\frac {k}{m}} \sqrt {1 \mp \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3} k}} \\ \approx \omega_ {0} \left[ 1 \mp \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3} m \omega_ {0} ^ {2}}\right) - \frac {1}{8} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3} m \omega_ {0} ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} + \dots \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

故

$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta V = E - E _ {0} = \frac {1}{2} \hbar (\omega_ {+} + \omega_ {-}) - \hbar \omega_ {0} \\ \approx - \hbar \omega_ {0} \frac {1}{8} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3} m \omega_ {0} ^ {2}}\right) ^ {2} \\ = - \frac {\hbar}{8 m ^ {2} \omega_ {0} ^ {3}} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}\right) ^ {2} \frac {1}{R ^ {6}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

(d) 对于基态，无微扰时的非简并被函数为

$$
\psi_ {0} \left(x _ {1}, x _ {2}\right) = \psi_ {0} \left(x _ {1}\right) \psi_ {0} \left(x _ {2}\right).
$$

故能量的一阶修正为

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {0} ^ {(1)} = \langle \psi_ {0} | H ^ {\prime} | \psi_ {0} \rangle = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}} \langle \psi_ {0} | x _ {1} x _ {2} | \psi_ {0} \rangle \\ = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}} \underbrace {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {0} ^ {*} \left(x _ {1}\right) x _ {1} \psi_ {0} \left(x _ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x _ {1}} _ {0} \underbrace {\int_ {- \infty} ^ {\infty} \psi_ {0} ^ {*} \left(x _ {2}\right) x _ {2} \psi_ {0} \left(x _ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} x _ {2}} _ {0} = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

能量的二阶修正为

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {0} ^ {(2)} = \sum_ {n, \ell = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {| \left\langle \psi_ {0 0} \right| H ^ {\prime} | \psi_ {n \ell} \rangle | ^ {2}}{E _ {0 , 0} ^ {(0)} - E _ {n , \ell} ^ {(0)}}, \qquad | \psi_ {0 0} \rangle \equiv | \psi_ {0} \rangle | \psi_ {0} \rangle , \quad | \psi_ {n \ell} \rangle \equiv | \psi_ {n} \rangle | \psi_ {\ell} \rangle , \\ = \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) ^ {2} \sum_ {n = 1} ^ {\infty} \sum_ {\ell = 1} ^ {\infty} \frac {| \langle \psi_ {0} | x _ {1} | \psi_ {n} \rangle | ^ {2} | \langle \psi_ {0} | x _ {2} | \psi_ {\ell} \rangle | ^ {2}}{E _ {0 , 0} ^ {(0)} - E _ {n , \ell} ^ {(0)}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

显跚然求棚和只盹有档当 n= ，山， $n = 1 , \ell = 1$ $\left. \psi _ { 0 } \right| x \left| \psi _ { 1 } \right. = { \sqrt { \frac { \hbar } { 2 m \omega _ { 0 } } } }$ ，所以2mwo

$$
E _ {0} ^ {(2)} = \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} R ^ {3}}\right) ^ {2} \frac {\left[ \hbar / (2 m \omega_ {0}) \right] ^ {2}}{\hbar \omega_ {0} - 3 \hbar \omega_ {0}} = - \frac {\hbar}{8 m ^ {2} \omega_ {0} ^ {3}} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{2 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}\right) ^ {2} \frac {1}{R ^ {6}},
$$

这与前面的结果一致.

牢牢习题 7.38 对一个特定的量子系统，设哈密顿量 $H$ 是某个参数 $\lambda$ 的函数;令$E _ { n } \left( \lambda \right)$ 和 $\psi _ { n } \left( \lambda \right)$ 为 $H \left( \lambda \right)$ 的本征值和本征函数.费曼一赫尔曼定理@指出:

$$
\frac {\partial E _ {n}}{\partial \lambda} = \left\langle \psi_ {n} \middle | \frac {\partial H}{\partial \lambda} \middle | \psi_ {n} \right\rangle
$$

(假定 $E _ { n }$ 非简井，或(如果简并的话) $\psi _ { n } s$ 为简并本征波函数"好"的线性组合).

(a) 证明:费曼一赫尔曼定理.提示 利用方程 (7.9).

(b) 将该定理应用于一维谐振子， (i) $\lambda = \omega$ (这将得出关于 $V$ 期望值的公式)， (ii) $\lambda = \hbar$ 这将得到 $\langle T \rangle$ ) (iii) $\lambda = m$ (这将得到 $\langle T \rangle$ 和 $\langle V \rangle$ 的一个关系式).将你的结果与习题 2.12 及位力定理的结果作对比(习题 3.37).

解答 (a) $E _ { n } \left( \lambda \right)$ 和 $\psi _ { n } \left( \lambda \right)$ 为 $H \left( \lambda \right)$ 的本征值和本征函数，所以有

$$
\left[ H (\lambda) - E _ {n} (\lambda) \right] \left| \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \right\rangle = 0. \quad (\text {能 量 本 征 方 程})
$$

对 $\lambda$ 求导，得

$$
\left[ \frac {\partial H (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} - \frac {\partial E _ {n} (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} \right] | \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle + [ H (\lambda) - E _ {n} (\lambda) ] \frac {\partial | \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle}{\partial \lambda} = 0,
$$

左乘 $\langle \psi _ { n } \left( \lambda \right) |$ ，得

$$
\langle \psi_ {n} (\lambda) | \left[ \frac {\partial H (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} - \frac {\partial E _ {n} (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} \right] | \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle + \langle \psi_ {n} (\lambda) | [ H (\lambda) - E _ {n} (\lambda) ] \frac {\partial | \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle}{\partial \lambda} = 0,
$$

$$
\langle \psi_ {n} (\lambda) | \left[ \frac {\partial H (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} - \frac {\partial E _ {n} (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} \right] | \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle + \langle \psi_ {n} (\lambda) | \underbrace {[ E _ {n} (\lambda) - E _ {n} (\lambda) ]} _ {0} \frac {\partial | \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle}{\partial \lambda} = 0,
$$

$$
\langle \psi_ {n} (\lambda) | \left[ \frac {\partial H (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} - \frac {\partial E _ {n} (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} \right] | \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle = 0,
$$

$$
\frac {\partial E _ {n} (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} \left\langle \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \right| \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \rangle = \frac {\partial E _ {n} (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} = \left\langle \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \right| \frac {\partial H (\lambda)}{\partial \lambda} \left| \psi_ {n} (\lambda) \right\rangle .
$$

其中利用了哈密顿算符的厄米性及本征态的归一性.

(b) 对于一维简谐振子:

$$
E _ {n} = \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega , H = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} x ^ {2},
$$

$$
\frac {\partial E _ {n}}{\partial \omega} = \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar , \quad \frac {\partial H}{\partial \omega} = m \omega x ^ {2}.
$$

由费曼赫尔曼定理，得

$$
\left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar = \langle n | m \omega x ^ {2} | n \rangle ,
$$

而

$$
\langle V \rangle = \left\langle n \left| \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} x ^ {2} \right| n \right\rangle = \frac {1}{2} \omega \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \Rightarrow \langle V \rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega = \frac {1}{2} E _ {n}.
$$

取 $\lambda = \hbar$ ，得

$$
\frac {\partial E _ {n}}{\partial \hbar} = \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \omega , \quad \frac {\partial H}{\partial \hbar} = - \frac {\hbar}{m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} = \frac {2}{\hbar} \left(- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}}\right) = \frac {2}{\hbar} T.
$$

由费曼-赫尔曼定理，得

$$
\left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \omega = \frac {2}{\hbar} \langle n | T | n \rangle \Rightarrow \langle T \rangle = \frac {1}{2} \left(n + \frac {1}{2}\right) \hbar \omega = \frac {1}{2} E _ {n}.
$$

取 $\lambda = m$ ，得

$$
\frac {\partial E _ {n}}{\partial m} = 0,
$$

$$
\frac {\partial H}{\partial m} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m ^ {2}} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}} + \frac {1}{2} \omega^ {2} x ^ {2} = - \frac {1}{m} \left(- \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \frac {\mathrm {d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm {d} x ^ {2}}\right) + \frac {1}{m} \left(\frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} x ^ {2}\right) = - \frac {1}{m} T + \frac {1}{m} V,
$$

由费曼赫尔曼定理，得 $0 = - { \frac { 1 } { m } } \left. T \right. + { \frac { 1 } { m } } \left. V \right. \Rightarrow \left. T \right. = \left. V \right.$ 1 ，这里的结果与习题 2.12 和习题 3.37的结果是一致的.
